deploy-bot: Starting cutover for release v1.24.0 -> routing rule alpha -> beta; traffic ramp schedule: 0% -> 10% -> 50% over 10m
alice: Noticed a small uptick in embed-route errors ~5m after cutover. Linking charts: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/embed-errors
ben: p95 latency on text-gen jumped from 120ms to 380ms in eu-west around 00:04 UTC. SLO panels show error budget drain: 2.3% -> 4.9%
carla: @dave can you run the quick smoke probe on the embed service? curl below:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' | jq .
```
dave: running now — getting a 502 with upstream timeout. logs:
```
[2026-03-21T00:06:12Z] embed-svc: upstream read timeout id=aa3f status=502 latency=1.02s
[2026-03-21T00:06:14Z] nginx: 502 from backend embed-pool-7
```
srebot: ALARM: embed-route 5xx rate crossed 0.8% threshold for 2 consecutive minutes. Auto-pause policy: enabled
deploy-bot: Auto-pause triggered at 00:07 UTC — rolling traffic back to baseline (0%). Rollback candidate: v1.23.8 pinned for alpha/beta. @oncall-sre please confirm manual rollback plan.
alice: +1 to pause. Start rollback and open release rollback task. I'll notify the product owner for release notes update.
ben: I'll take traces and k-v cache heatmap. If this is a cold-cache regression from quantize change, we should re-evaluate batch sizing before next attempt.
carla: adding postmortem checklist to the task and tagging @affects-embeds. action items: revert binary -> monitor 10m p95, validate kvcache priming scripts.

(reactions: alice :thumbsup: on deploy-bot, dave :eyes: on srebot)
